To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The most important factors for the internationalization of Malaysian firms are the market attractiveness, the government policy, the incompatibility with foreign practices and the need for adaptation of products and services to foreign markets.

Malaysian entrepreneurs are motivated by the desire to grow their business and that they are willing to take on the risks of international entrepreneurship, but that there are many barriers to international entrepreneurship that they face.

the barriers to international entrepreneurship in Malaysia are export market attractiveness, foreign business practices being incompatible with Malaysian business practices, adapting to foreign market conditions and needs, and government policies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the internationalisation of Malaysian SMEs.
understanding the factors impacting the internationalization of SMEs in Malaysia.
the factors influencing internationalization and the barriers to it, and how they impact international entrepreneurship.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the internationalization of the Malaysian firms is a process that is not only driven by the firm's internal resources and capabilities, but also by the external environmental factors.
international entrepreneurship is the process of creating value through the use of resources and the opportunity to reconfigure business activities across geographical borders.
the Malaysian entrepreneurs are not only aware of the benefits of exporting but also of the importance of internationalisation in general.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that there is no single, universal, and all-encompassing model of entrepreneurship.
the barriers to international entrepreneurship are not only related to the firm, but also to the external factors such as the government policy and the foreign market.
we have shown the importance of the international entrepreneurship literature in the field of international business.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the barriers to international entrepreneurship are different for firms in different industries.

internationalization of firms is not only driven by market factors but is also driven by factors such as government policies, the compatibility of foreign practices with domestic business, and adaptation of foreign markets to the needs of the firm.
international entrepreneurship is a complex phenomenon.
